jobs.description:
This large Belgian company plays a key role and manages an extensive and technically complex network. Behind the scenes, high-performing and reliable IT systems ensure that operational processes run safely and efficiently. Within this business-critical environment, significant investments are being made in modern software development and sustainable IT architecture.
You will join an experienced team operating in an Enterprise environment where quality, collaboration, and long-term vision are central.

Jobomschrijving

You will work as part of a team on the further development and optimization of applications using a modern version of .NET & Angular, with a strong focus on performance, testing, and clean code. You ensure stable communication between various internal systems.
Beyond your operational involvement, you will also have input into the broader technical direction. Within the team, you will have the opportunity to initiate technical improvements and actively contribute to building a robust and future-proof IT environment.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience with .NET
• At least a first hands-on experience with Angular
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

For an international manufacturing company in the Aalst region, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to help ensure the optimal operation of an advanced machine park.
 

You will work in a two-shift system:
 

 
• Early shift: 06:00–14:00
 
• Late shift: 14:00–22:00 
 

As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for maintaining, repairing and improving industrial machinery and technical installations. Thanks to your expertise, production processes remain reliable and downtime is kept to a minimum.
 

Your tasks and responsibilities
 

 
• Carrying out preventive maintenance on production machines, injection moulding machines and auxiliary equipment.
 
• Troubleshooting electrical, mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic faults.
 
• Carrying out corrective repairs in the event of technical breakdowns.
 
• Analysing faults and looking for sustainable solutions.
 
• Independently carrying out small technical projects and improvements.
 
• Actively contributing to optimizations aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of the machine park.
 
• Working closely with the production department to minimize downtime.
 
• Working according to applicable safety, quality and environmental standards.
 
• Helping to maintain a clean, safe and well-organized working environment. 

You have a strong technical background and enjoy working hands-on.
 

In addition, you have:
 

 
• A technical qualification in Electromechanics, Electrical Engineering, Automation or a similar technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
 
• Experience in the maintenance and repair of industrial machinery.
 
• Knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance in a production environment.
 
• Basic knowledge of PLC control systems is an advantage. If you have limited experience in this area, you will have the opportunity to develop this knowledge internally.
 
• Experience with injection moulding machines is an advantage, but is not required.
 
• A good command of Dutch.
 
• The ability to understand technical documentation in English and/or German.
 
• Strong analytical skills and a solution-oriented approach.
 
• A hands-on mentality and a strong sense of responsibility.
 
• Good team spirit combined with the ability to carry out interventions independently.

As a trusted partner to Supply Chain and business stakeholders, you will:

 
• Develop and enhance Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions.
 
• Analyze Order-to-Delivery (OTD) and OTIF performance to identify trends and improvement opportunities.
 
• Translate business needs into actionable reporting and analytics tools.
 
• Support the EMEA Supply Chain S/4HANA reporting roadmap.
 
• Collaborate with Supply Chain, IT, and project teams to design, test, and deploy new reporting capabilities.
 
• Deliver meaningful insights that drive operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.
 
• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives through data-driven decision-making.

Must-Have Skills

 
• Professional proficiency in English
 
• Advanced knowledge of Power BI, Power Query, DAX, and Excel
 
• Strong understanding of end-to-end Order-to-Delivery (OTD) processes and OTIF performance drivers
 
• Experience building reporting and analytics solutions
 
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
 
• Experience working within a SAP environment

Nice-to-Have Skills

 
• Experience with SAP S/4HANA and Supply Assignment (ARun)
 
• Knowledge of OTIF and OTD performance reporting
 
• Experience translating business requirements into reporting solutions and collaborating with IT teams
 
• Familiarity with Power Automate, Power Apps, Python, or BW/HANA
 
• Experience as a Reporting SME, Product Owner, or Business Analyst
 
• Continuous Improvement or Lean experience

jobs.occupation: Senior CAPEX Project Manager - Industrial Engineering
jobs.description:
Industrial CAPEX project environment

As Project Manager, you take end-to-end responsibility for complex multidisciplinary investment projects within an industrial process setting. You manage the complete lifecycle and remain accountable for scope, budget, timing, quality and safety. The work includes both greenfield developments and major modifications to existing industrial installations.

Key responsibilities

• Manage industrial engineering projects from feasibility and concept definition through to commissioning and final handover to operations.
• Define and control project scope, deliverables, budget, business case, investment approval and the baseline planning in MS Project.
• Drive every project phase, including pre-study, concept selection, basic and detailed engineering, procurement, contractor selection, construction, on-site execution, commissioning and transfer.
• Act as the primary accountable contact for stakeholders and management during the full course of the project.
• Coordinate multidisciplinary internal and external teams covering mechanical, electrical, automation, piping, civil and EHS expertise.
• Manage scope changes, project risks, claims and deviations affecting cost or schedule.
• Report clearly on progress, decisions and issues to steering committees and senior stakeholders.

Technical profile requirements

• You have at least 10 years of experience as a Project Manager, with proven end-to-end ownership of industrial CAPEX projects.
• You also bring at least 7 years of experience as a Project Engineer in disciplines such as mechanical, electrical, piping or civil engineering.
• You have solid experience with pre-feasibility and concept studies, CAPEX budgeting, investment approval processes and the commissioning of industrial installations.
• Experience in the process industry is required.
• You have strong hands-on expertise in MS Project and are used to creating and owning project schedules, not merely following them up.
• You work at academic level and combine strong analytical skills with a broad helicopter view.
Non-technical profile requirements

• You work independently and take full ownership of your assignments.
• You show strong leadership and can challenge stakeholders and contractors when needed.
• You communicate confidently with stakeholders at all organisational levels.
• You bring natural authority in complex industrial environments.
Methodology / certification requirements

• VCA-Vol is mandatory.
• PMP / Prince2 is a plus.
Language proficiencies

• Dutch: Native / Fluent
• English: Fluent

For our client in the Veurne region, we are looking for a SOLAR PANEL TECHNICIAN.

Our client is a well-established company with years of experience in providing sustainable energy solutions. With a strong passion for technology and technical installations, they are committed to helping build a greener future. Would you like to contribute to the transition towards renewable energy in Belgium and neighboring countries? Then keep reading!

As a SOLAR PANEL TECHNICIAN in the Veurne region, your responsibilities will include:

  • Connecting solar panel installations, home battery systems, and/or EV charging stations;
  • Installing the inverter and providing the required AC and DC cabling according to industry standards;
  • Connecting the AC and DC cables to the inverter;
  • Making any necessary modifications to the electrical distribution board;
  • Completing the single-line electrical diagram to ensure the technical inspection can be carried out;
  • Commissioning the complete installation and providing the customer with clear instructions and explanations on its operation.

As a SOLAR PANEL TECHNICIAN, you recognize yourself in the following profile:

  • You hold a valid Category B driving licence;
  • You have a strong electrical background (experience with solar panels is an advantage but can be taught);
  • You are able to read and interpret technical drawings with ease;
  • You speak Dutch or English;
  • You have a strong focus on safety and always follow the correct procedures and regulations.

jobs.occupation: IT & Cyber Risk Specialist – HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
Your Job at a glance

Ready to Shape the Future of Cybersecurity in Banking?

At the heart of BNP Paribas Fortis, the Centre of Expertise Security (CoE Security) drives innovation in secure solutions, designing, implementing, and maintaining trusted, cutting-edge protections for our teams and clients.

As an IT Cyber Risk Manager, you will operate at the core of our cybersecurity strategy, connecting, influencing, and collaborating across the entire bank. Within our ‘Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC)’ team, you will work closely with IT and Business Units to redefine Operational Risk Management, with a sharp focus on IT and Cyber Security.

This is not just a risk management role - it’s an opportunity to:

• Engage diverse stakeholders, from technical teams to C-level executives, across all areas of BNP Paribas Fortis.
• Drive creative solutions, transforming complex cyber risks into practical, forward-thinking strategies.
• Shape a resilient future by proactively managing cyber risks to strengthen the bank’s defenses.
If you thrive in a dynamic, cross-functional environment where innovation and collaboration are key, this is your chance to make a tangible impact in banking cybersecurity

 

And in detail

Your Key Role as IT & Cyber Risk Specialist :

You serve as the critical link between technical risks, business priorities, and strategic decisions, ensuring IT and cybersecurity risks are proactively identified, analyzed, and translated into actionable strategies—fully aligned with the bank’s objectives.

Why this role stands out:

• Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Tribes, Functions, and Business Units, clearly articulating risks to both technical teams and leadership—enabling data-driven decision-making.
• Proactive risk intelligence: From Shadow IT exposures to operational vulnerabilities, you assess, prioritize, and drive mitigation, delivering practical solutions that balance security with business continuity.
• Strategic advisory: Provide targeted recommendations to IT and business stakeholders, ensuring risks are managed without compromising operational goals.
• Enterprise-wide alignment: Report risks, trends, and insights to Cyber Security, IT, and Business Management, while sharing best practices across the BNP Paribas Group—reinforcing a unified risk posture.
• Process optimization: Leverage your expertise to refine risk management methods and tools, ensuring they remain efficient, scalable, and future-ready."

Your talents and skills

• Risk-to-Solution Mindset: You break down complex IT and cybersecurity challenges, turning them into clear, actionable insights for leadership—viewing risks as solvable challenges, not just warnings.
• Bank-Specific Acumen: Deep understanding of BNP Paribas Fortis’ businesses, functions, and strategic goals, ensuring risk management aligns with our priorities.
• Technical + Risk Expertise: Hands-on experience in IT infrastructure, architecture, and security, blending technical knowledge with risk awareness to design practical solutions—not just identify risks.
• Multilingual Communication: Fluent in French or Dutch + professional English, with strong written and verbal persuasion skills. You adapt seamlessly between IT, business, and management discussions.
• Practical Framework Application: Proven ability to operationalize IT processes, Cyber Security Management Systems, and control frameworks—ensuring they deliver in practice.
• Certifications & Methodologies: CISSP, CISM, Operational Risk Management, or Agile experience are a plus, but not mandatory.

Are you passionate about cybersecurity, threat detection, and defending organizations against evolving cyber threats?

We are looking for a Cyber Security Analyst to join a leading international cybersecurity organization in Belgium. You’ll work alongside experienced security professionals, using modern technologies and security frameworks to detect, investigate, and respond to cyber incidents.
Role
As a Cyber Security Analyst, you will be responsible for monitoring security environments, investigating potential threats, and supporting customers during security incidents.

Key responsibilities include:

Take ownership of scalable web applications, shape technical architecture and build robust solutions with PHP, Symfony & Vue.js.

Our partner is looking for an experienced Senior Full Stack Engineer to strengthen its development team.

You will work on scalable web applications, contribute to key architectural decisions and take ownership of technical topics across the stack.

The position combines hands-on development with architecture, code quality and knowledge sharing in a collaborative environment.
Senior Full Stack Engineer | Role
• Design, develop and maintain scalable web applications with PHP & Symfony at the core.
• Contribute to system architecture and solution design, focusing on security, performance, scalability and maintainability.
• Develop APIs and integrations, including asynchronous communication patterns.
• Work across the stack on backend services with PHP/Symfony and frontend features with Vue.js.
• Implement automated testing and collaborate on GitLab CI/CD pipelines and deployment practices.
• Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, knowledge sharing and mentoring within the team.
Senior Full Stack Engineer | Profile
• You have 10+ years of experience as a Full Stack or Backend Engineer.
• You have strong expertise in PHP & Symfony and a solid understanding of web architecture, design patterns and best practices.
• You are comfortable with MySQL/PostgreSQL, caching solutions and asynchronous or distributed systems concepts.
• You have experience with GitLab CI/CD, modern DevOps practices and Docker.
• You have experience with automated testing and bring strong problem-solving skills in collaborative, agile environments.
• You communicate confidently in English.
• Knowledge of TypeScript, Vue.js or Python is considered an asset.

Responsibilities

• Develop new application features using modern frontend and backend frameworks.
• Support the modernization and rewriting of legacy functionalities to ensure technical longevity.
• Collaborate with existing development teams to maintain architectural consistency.
• Enhance application security and data quality within central data management platforms.
• Migrate legacy application components to a unified modern technology stack.

Requirements

• 5+ years of frontend development using Angular.
• 5+ years of backend development with Java and Spring Boot.
• 3+ years of experience with REST, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
• 3+ years of experience with SQL.
• You are proactive and solution-oriented.
• You have an active knowledge of Dutch, French, and English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with Angular 17 or higher.
• Familiarity with legacy technologies including Java EE and JSF.
• Knowledge of HR data management systems.

Responsibilities

• Design and coordinate the full implementation trajectory of the Critical Entities Resilience (CER) legislation.
• Ensure the organization meets all legal obligations regarding the resilience of critical entities.
• Implement organizational, technical, and operational measures to safeguard service continuity.
• Coordinate risk management, business continuity, and crisis management processes within the project.
• Connect and lead multidisciplinary teams to align on compliance and governance objectives.
• Follow up on legislative and organizational requirements to ensure demonstrable compliance.

Requirements

• You bring 5+ years of experience in Project Management, Compliance, Risk Management, or Business Continuity.
• You possess expert knowledge in Risk Management, Crisis Management, and Business Continuity Management (BCM).
• You have a strong understanding of Compliance and Governance processes.
• You bring affinity with infrastructure and operational security processes.
• You're analytically strong and risk-oriented with excellent coordination skills.
• You possess outstanding communication and stakeholder management skills.
• You are native or bilingual in Dutch.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with organization-wide change projects.
• Knowledge of English.

What you will do 
 

You will join our SEM-TEM operations team within the FAB, where we perform both in-line and out-of-line electron microscopy inspections. These inspections are essential at various stages of process development, enabling us to characterise materials and processes at wafer level with a high degree of precision. By delivering accurate and timely insights, we support our internal customers in developing innovative chip manufacturing processes that meet ever more demanding requirements. To achieve this, we rely on cutting-edge cleanroom facilities and highly advanced equipment. In this role, you will help ensure the health, quality and reliability of our microscopy tools through close collaboration with equipment suppliers and internal users. In short, you will support the teams carrying out microscopy analyses and contribute to the smooth and high-quality execution of SEM and TEM inspections. 
 
 

• As a SEM/TEM Hardware Assistant Technician, your key responsibilities will include:  

• Monitoring and following up on the overall health and performance of the tools.  

• Acting as the main point of contact with equipment suppliers to report, discuss and resolve tool-related issues.  

• Serving as the first point of contact for internal users when tool health or performance issues arise.  

• Contributing to the achievement of hardware performance targets and key performance indicators (KPIs).  

• Supporting statistical process control (SPC) activities for TEM tools to help maintain stable and reliable performance.  

Who you are 
 
 

• You hold a bachelor’s degree in a scientific field such as physics, engineering, chemistry, or another relevant discipline. (or equivalent by relevant experience)  

• Hands-on experience with laboratory tools, microscopy equipment or micromachining systems would be a strong advantage.  

• You are well organised, able to plan effectively, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where multitasking and setting priorities are essential.  

• You are a communicative team player with a good command of English.  

• You are willing to work in a shift system, including early, late and night shifts, (24/7) as well as one weekend in four.

You will spend around 90% of your time in the field. Working with a colleague, you will carry out maintenance, inspections and technical interventions on specialised installations in the rail environment. Most assignments are in Antwerp, Brussels and Ghent, with additional interventions elsewhere. 
 
• Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on technical installations. 
• Analyse and resolve mechanical, electromechanical and electrical faults. 
• Assess technical situations independently and help determine the appropriate course of action. 
• Carry out measurements, inspections and interventions using professional tools and test equipment. 
• Liaise with colleagues, engineers and project managers. 
• Depending on your experience, coordinate activities and take a leading role in the field.  
Rail experience is an advantage, but not essential. You bring a solid technical background and relevant practical experience; Buhlmann will teach you the specific installations, procedures and safety requirements of the rail environment. Experience in industrial maintenance, machine building, installation engineering or field service can be highly relevant.
 
After your induction period, you will take part in the on-call rota. Urgent night-time interventions are limited to a few occasions per year. In addition, there is on average around one planned night intervention per month, with time off in lieu afterwards.

We are looking for an experienced technician who knows the trade, can tackle technical problems independently and takes responsibility for safe, high-quality execution. 
 
• Technical qualification in electromechanics, mechanics, electricity, or equivalent experience. 
• Several years of relevant practical experience in maintenance, industrial installations, machine building, field service or a comparable technical environment. 
• Strong foundation in mechanics and electromechanics, complemented by sufficient electrical knowledge. 
• You analyse problems methodically, work independently and consult others when the situation requires it. 
• You enjoy field work and are comfortable in a role involving travel to different sites. 
• Experience as a lead technician, team leader or site supervisor is an advantage; even in such a role, you still want to remain technically involved. 
• You can communicate operationally in Dutch and/or French and have sufficient English for technical communication.

jobs.occupation: Administrative Officer - Technical Sales Support & Logistics
jobs.description:
Navision, order processing and follow-up form the core of the role – but the position is clearly broader than traditional order administration. 

As Administrative Officer – Technical Sales Support & Logistics, you are a key link between customers, suppliers and your colleagues. As you gain experience, you can also become more involved in logistics follow-up and the administrative support of technical projects.
  
• Process and follow up customer orders in Microsoft Dynamics Navision. 
• Prepare quotations, order confirmations and purchase orders. 
• Place orders with suppliers and actively follow up delivery dates. 
• Support customers with questions about parts, spare parts and service. 
• Request prices and quotations from suppliers. 
• Follow up transport, deliveries, incoming goods and stock information. 
• Work closely with sales, project managers, engineers and technicians. 
• Occasionally provide practical support with a delivery or in the warehouse.  
The practical logistics component is limited – around 5 to 10% of the role – but it reflects the way Buhlmann works: colleagues do not constantly draw a line around where one job description ends and another begins.
 
Once you know the organisation well, your responsibilities can expand towards project support, for example project files in SharePoint, material orders, delivery follow-up and administrative preparation for invoicing.

Above all, we are looking for someone who is administratively strong, takes responsibility and shows initiative. 

You preferably have relevant experience in order administration, purchasing, sales support, customer service, logistics administration or a technical sales support role. You do not need to be a technical specialist, but an interest in a technical environment is important.
  
• Experience with an ERP system; knowledge of Navision is a strong advantage. SAP or a comparable system also provides a good basis. 
• You work accurately and in a structured way and can keep several files, deliveries and deadlines under control at the same time. 
• You take initiative: if a supplier needs to be chased or a file needs further investigation, you do not simply wait. 
• You are collegial and practically minded and do not mind occasionally helping with a delivery. 
• You are fluent in Dutch and can communicate professionally in English. French is a clear advantage; German is a welcome extra.

You will work closely with one or several Client Relationship Managers and play a key role in ensuring excellent service delivery to clients.

Your responsibilities as Client Administration Officer

As a Client Administration Officer, you will provide comprehensive administrative support while ensuring a high level of service to both clients and internal stakeholders.

Administrative & Executive Support

• Managing complex agendas and coordinating meetings
• Screening and handling calls, emails, and correspondence
• Welcoming clients and visitors
• Organizing meeting rooms and coordinating logistics
• Preparing presentations and administrative documentation
• Managing and maintaining client files and archives
• Ensuring smooth communication between clients, advisors, and internal teams
• Maintaining and updating client information in internal databases
Client & Financial Administration

• Supporting the opening of bank accounts in coordination with Compliance
• Following up on investment-related administrative processes
• Processing and monitoring financial transactions and investment orders
• Preparing reports, dashboards, and administrative analyses
• Ensuring accurate and compliant client documentation
• Supporting advisors in the day-to-day management of client relationships

Your profile as Client Administration Officer

• Bachelor in Office Management, Management Assistant, or equivalent experience
• Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar administrative support role
• Experience within a professional services environment (financial services, consulting, legal, wealth management, etc.) is a strong asset
• Excellent knowledge of Dutch, with a good command of French and English
• Strong administrative and organizational skills
• Affinity with numbers and financial environments
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently
• Strong attention to detail and accuracy
• Service-oriented, proactive, and solution-driven mindset
• High level of discretion and professionalism
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
• Experience with CRM systems or databases is an asset
